## Scope Boundary Options

### Option A: Replacement MVP

| Boundary | Content |
|---|---|
| In scope | Restricted access, recorded sessions, video playback, category/date filters, search, supporting materials, responsive access, admin publishing, access revocation, protected routes/files, HTTPS, backup/restore, monitoring, and activity logging. |
| Out of scope | Community feed, comments, classroom hierarchy, calendar, moderation, payments, discovery, points, direct messaging, multiple communities, native apps, advanced analytics, SSO, and migration. |
| Evidence strength | Strongest; based on accepted request and historical delivered scope. |
| Delivery risk | Lower than Option B, subject to platform and environment decisions. |

### Option B: Skool-Inspired MVP

| Boundary | Content |
|---|---|
| In scope | Option A plus community posts/comments/categories/announcements, classroom courses/modules/lessons, calendar events, participant/moderator/admin roles, and defined moderation. |
| Out of scope | Payments, discovery, points, direct messaging, multiple communities, native apps, advanced analytics, SSO unless reopened, and migration. |
| Evidence strength | Core replacement features are evidenced; added features are proposed only. |
| Delivery risk | Higher because it adds unvalidated features within the fixed launch window. |

## Constraints and Assumptions

| Item | State | Scope effect |
|---|---|---|
| September 11 program date | Active constraint | Requires a launch boundary and fallback. |
| No Skool subscription budget | User direction | Requires self-hosted/open-source implementation. |
| Existing server | Available for WordPress; web-app capability unknown | Technical scope depends on environment verification. |
| Restricted participants | Active constraint | Access and file controls are launch requirements. |
| YouTube | Historical dependency; new approach unresolved | Video protection must state residual risk. |
| Existing content migration | Deferred in proposed plan | Launch content must be separately inventoried. |
| Scope authority | Not named for baseline | PM direction is required before commitment. |

## Evidence Conclusion

PM-12 should present both scope options and recommend the evidence-supported Replacement MVP unless the PM and LeadLab Director explicitly accept the additional Skool-inspired features and their schedule risk. No scope baseline should be established until the boundary and authority gaps are resolved.
